functions.open: EAX status(RCX exactOwner128*,RDX exactOwnerPool128*) -- before Java, no heap allocation or Class initialization
functions.close: EAX status(RCX exactOwner128*) -- all callers ended, heap alive, explicit monitor/registry preguard before close
functions.resolve: Normal native handler(RCX Context32*,RDX four argvQ,R8 original registration pool*) -> same MemberName/null
functions.vm_info: Normal native handler(RCX Context32*,RDX argv{MemberName},R8 original registration pool*) -> normal Object[2]

owner_states.2: CLOSING rejects new admissions, permits already admitted completion

record_states.1: PREPARING temporary roots; preparing counter blocks close and no native lock spans a Java callback

roots: Exactly two ordinary strong collector cells per native Record128, interpreted by record state; no Java oops embedded in the native record.
reserve_publication: All possible Java callbacks/target mirror loads precede fresh RMN allocation. object_new -> native intern publishes strong root before another Java callback. Racing unused candidates become ordinary garbage, never force-freed.
GC_scope: Existing explicit quiescent, nonmoving collection only; no automatic/concurrent GC and no claim that arbitrary native locals are auto roots. VMInfo array is explicitly in a PREPARING root pair across Long.ensure; scratch cleanup does not inspect Context.kind.

scratch_functions.release: EAX status(owner,Scratch32*) -- finally even when Context pending

Scratch32: indexD,reserved0D,generationQ,exactRootPairQ,reserved0Q; no Java oop in this token
VMInfo_boxing: Original native order: fresh normal Object[2], real Long Class.ensure, normal fresh Long object_new plus original value field=-2; no Java constructor/valueOf/LongCache
lifetime: Fixed image/known source loader identities only. Close clears roots only after complete native row/root preflight and external Java/monitor quiescence. No unloading/redefinition/weak RMN cache.
supported: Original normal MethodType + REF6/IS_METHOD; class own/super ordinary methods, interface own static methods; public/sameclass/same runtime package/protected static/validated nest member access; known source loader descriptor constraints.
unsupported: maximally-specific inherited interface method selection when a matching method exists
custom/dynamic loaders or generated method owners/signature types beyond original descriptor prefix
VerifyMethodHandles debug-only trusted-lookup extra checks and ancient relaxed access policy
diagnostic_messages: Typed error classes and required order; initial method-error text is generic and is not asserted exact to all original JDK diagnostics

root_semantics.FREE: Both cells0 and the entire native Record128 zero
root_semantics.PREPARING: Temporary normal VM oops: cell0 freshly allocated VMInfo Object[2], cell1 fresh Long after allocation (0 earlier). Zero roots are allowed before allocation. Not a canonical RMN cache entry.
root_semantics.LIVE: cell0 canonical normal ResolvedMethodName, cell1 actual declaring-holder Class mirror; neither is the lookup caller
